subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB345
title: Requires a court to award damages for the cost of replanting to a plaintiff prevailing against the federal government or a contractor in an action for injury to private land arising from a fire originating on federal forestland.
headline: SB 345 did not pass

claims.text: SB 345 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.
SB 345 was still in a Senate committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
